title: Which devices and apps does augo integrate with?
seoTitle: Devices and Apps augo Integrates With | augo support
description: augo connects to Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Zwift and Strava. All seven sync activities and bring in your history. Four also receive planned workouts.
summary: augo connects to Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Zwift and Strava. The athlete connects once from the augo app, and from then on completed activities arrive automatically and the last 30 days are brought in. Garmin, Coros, Wahoo and Suunto also receive planned workouts on the device. If you connected Garmin before this changed, reconnect it.

body.html:
What each integration can do

Every integration does at least one of three things:

  • Planned workouts. The workouts your coach plans in augo always show up in your augo app. Garmin, Coros, Wahoo and Suunto also receive them directly, so you can follow the session on the watch or bike computer. See which workouts are delivered to my device?
  • Completed activities. Every workout you finish after connecting arrives in augo automatically, usually within minutes.
  • Historical activities. Every integration also brings in your last 30 days of activities from before you connected, and we can go back up to five years on request. See how does historical backfill work?

Compatibility at a glance

Device or appPlanned workouts to deviceCompleted activitiesHistorical activities
Garmin✓✓✓
Coros✓✓✓
Wahoo✓✓✓
Suunto✓✓✓
Polar—✓✓
Zwift—✓✓
Strava—✓✓

All seven bring in your last 30 days when you connect them. Garmin, Coros, Wahoo and Suunto also take the planned workout onto the device itself.

If you connected Garmin before this changed

Garmin history and planned workouts to the device are new. A Garmin connection made before they existed was authorised without the permissions they need, so nothing from before the connection comes in and planned workouts stay in the app.

The fix is to connect Garmin again from the augo app and approve the permissions Garmin asks for. Nothing you already have in augo is removed. Once it's done, your last 30 days come in and planned workouts start reaching the device.

If you are connecting Garmin for the first time, there is nothing to do — the new permissions are part of the normal connection.

One connection is enough

You only need to connect one source, as long as it carries every workout you do. If your watch already pushes everything to Strava, connecting Strava alone is enough. If some sessions only live on the watch — say indoor rides that never reach Strava — connect the watch too. Connecting more than one source is fine: augo recognises the same activity coming from two places and won't show it twice.

If you want planned workouts on your device, connect the device itself: Strava is an app, and it can't put a workout on your watch. The table above shows what each one can do.

Who connects the account

The athlete connects their own device or app, from their own augo account. A coach can't connect an athlete's Garmin or Coros on their behalf, because the authorisation belongs to the account that owns the data.

Coaches: if a new athlete's training feed is empty, this is the first thing to check. They have joined, but haven't linked a data source yet.

Not supported today

Apple Health, Whoop and Oura are not connected sources yet. If you or your athletes rely on one of these, tell us through the feedback button in the app — what coaches ask for shapes what gets added next.

TrainingPeaks is a different case. It isn't a data source, and augo is built to sit alongside it rather than replace it.

If a workout is missing

A session has to finish uploading from the watch to Garmin, Coros, Strava or whichever source is connected before augo can see it. That usually takes a few minutes, longer if the watch hasn't synced with its own app yet.

If a workout still hasn't appeared after an hour, use the feedback button in the augo app and tell us which device you use and when the session was. We'll take a look.

faqs.question: Which devices does augo integrate with?
faqs.answer: augo connects to Garmin, Coros, Wahoo, Suunto, Polar, Zwift and Strava. All seven sync completed activities and bring in your last 30 days of history. Garmin, Coros, Wahoo and Suunto also receive planned workouts on the device.

faqs.question: Do I need to reconnect my Garmin?
faqs.answer: Only if you connected it before augo added Garmin history and planned workouts. That connection doesn't carry the permissions those need, so connect Garmin again from the augo app and approve what it asks for. New connections already include them.

faqs.question: Does augo work with Apple Health, Whoop or Oura?
faqs.answer: Not yet. If your athletes depend on one of these, let us know through the feedback button in the app. Coach demand drives what gets added.

faqs.question: Do I need to connect both my watch and Strava?
faqs.answer: Only if some workouts exist in one place but not the other. One source is enough when it carries everything you do. Connecting both is fine and won't duplicate activities. Connect the watch itself if you want planned workouts on the device.

faqs.question: Can a coach connect an athlete's device for them?
faqs.answer: No. The athlete connects their own device or app from their own augo account, because the authorisation belongs to the account that owns the data. An empty training feed for a new athlete usually means this step hasn't happened yet.
